explanation: This fires only at D2 on trials where the agent chose a1 and got the rare transition to S2: it is about 9 the first time that happens, and 10 when the previous trial was also a rare a1-to-S2 trial or the episode is late (after trial 85). At every other step it is 0: all D1 and GO steps, every common transition, and every trial where the agent chose a2, including a2 trials that rarely reach S1.
